label: A group raised up above ten million dollars
description: A word that a group of people will be raised into wealth above ten million dollars each, the term decamillionaire given to him and looked up afterwards, offered as a sign and a wonder in the last days. Given 30 September 2024.

label: Israelis celebrate in the streets that the deliverer has come
description: A major event in Israel after which people fill the streets with flags draped over their shoulders, dancing and saying the deliverer has come, celebrating a victory or a deliverance he says he cannot identify. Given 5 September 2024.
aliases: celebrating in the streets of israel

label: His marriage ending was shown to him in advance
description: He says the visitation showed him his wife leaving in a named year he withholds, his daughter moving to Texas with her, custody every other weekend, her remarriage to a man he was shown, and his own bitterness afterwards.

label: An event shakes the USA and the fearful lose their control
description: An event that shakes the United States, said of the Democratic Party and what he calls the evil over America, after which those who hold control out of fear lose it. Given 5 September 2024.
aliases: an event that will shake the usa

label: Told never to quote dates any more
description: A stated instruction to stop quoting dates, to be slow to speak and quick to pray, and to spend more time praying and less time speaking on the channel, so that listeners learn to hear for themselves. Given 5 September 2024.
aliases: slow to speak and quick to pray

label: The coming virus is engineered in a laboratory
description: The pestilence he warns of is not natural but built: a laboratory, artificial intelligence writing DNA like computer code, and a strain far more dangerous than COVID, with China named as the party cooking it up.

label: Obama and elderly European businessmen steering the American economy
description: A walled path with Obama on one side telling someone what to do and, on the other, a group of wealthy elderly men in business suits in Europe with interests in the American economy giving instructions. Seen in the one hour vision, told 10 August 2024.
aliases: very big businessmen telling him what to do

label: The market falls so far are only Braxton Hicks
description: Told during the open eye vision that the stock market drops seen so far are Braxton Hicks rather than real labour, with the added statement that the economic event itself will not be stopped. Given 8 August 2024.

label: A device in the belly of a green train out of Germany
description: A green train carrying an explosive device in its belly, running out of Germany into the Paris area, which he links loosely to the Olympics and to what he calls the green agenda going down. Given 15 July 2024.
aliases: explosive device in the belly of a train

label: North Korea liberated and its leadership dealt with
description: Liberation for the people of North Korea like the children of Israel, a holy terror on the leader, his family and the regime, and a shaking of the nation that he says will not be reported in the news. Given 25 July 2024.
aliases: liberation to the people of north korea

label: A bullet passes by his ear and bursts the eardrum
description: A claimed prior vision of an attempt on Trump's life in which the bullet flies past his ear close enough to burst the eardrum, after which he falls to his knees and worships. Told on 13 and 14 July 2024, the day of and the day after the Butler shooting; no earlier telling appears in this archive.
